task.title: Margins and padding
task.shortdesc: Margins put space between a box and the boxes around it. Padding puts space between the content of a box and its border.

info.p: The margin property sets the space outside the border. It takes one to four values:

ul.li: One value sets all four sides.
Two values set the top and the bottom, then the left and the right.
Three values set the top, then the left and the right, then the bottom.
Four values set the top, the right, the bottom and the left, clockwise from the top.

info.p: Each side also has its own property: margin-top, margin-right, margin-bottom and margin-left. A margin can be a length, a percentage or auto, and it can be negative. The initial value is 0.
A percentage is a part of the width of the containing block, also for the top and the bottom margins.
An auto margin takes the free space that is left in the containing block. When a box has a width and both side margins are auto, the box is centered:

info.note: The vertical margins of boxes that follow each other collapse. The space between them is the larger of the two margins, not their sum. Two margins of 20pt leave 20pt, not 40pt.

image.alt: Two pairs of stacked boxes. In the first pair, the margins add up to a gap of 40pt, which is not what happens. In the second pair, the two margins overlap and the gap is 20pt.

step.cmd: Set the margins by the direction of the text

info.p: The logical margin properties name the sides by the direction of the text, so they follow the writing mode of the element. margin-block-start and margin-block-end are the sides at the start and the end of the block axis. margin-inline-start and margin-inline-end are the sides at the start and the end of a line. margin-block and margin-inline set the two sides of an axis, the start first. With one value, both sides are equal.
In horizontal text that reads from left to right, this step has 6pt above, 12pt below and 18pt on the left and on the right.

The padding property takes the same one to four values as margin, but it cannot be negative, auto does not exist for it, and the padding of two boxes never collapses. The background of a box is painted under its padding, and not under its margin.

The properties padding-top, padding-right, padding-bottom and padding-left set one side. The logical ones are padding-block-start, padding-block-end, padding-inline-start, padding-inline-end, and the pairs padding-block and padding-inline. The initial value is 0. A percentage is a part of the width of the containing block.

step.cmd: Choose what happens to a margin at a page break

info.p: A box can break across two pages. The margin-break property decides what happens to the margins that touch the break:

ul.li: auto is the initial value. At a break that CSSMedia chooses, a margin before the break is cut to the space that is left on the page and a margin after it is zero. At a break that you force, the margin before the break is cut and the margin after it stays.
discard removes the margins at the break, also at the top of the first page and at the bottom of the last one.
